column4: 你被僵尸淹没了。快复活，赢取更多奖励！

column4: 每撑过一波尸群、每救下一名幸存者，都能获得经验和{0}

column4: 你的医疗箱用完了，快补充吧。

column3: Use better equipment to deal with greater challenge.
column4: 换上更好的装备，迎接更大的挑战。

column4: 确定要退出任务吗？（所有奖励都将丢失）

column3: TUTORIAL1. The introduction provides the background information needed to properly understand the story
column4: 教程1：介绍理解剧情所需的背景信息。

column3: We really need to figure out how this whole event started. Lets be sure you have all the skills you need to be successful. Then we can explore the facility.
column4: 我们得查清这一切是怎么开始的。先确保你掌握了需要的全部技能，然后再去探索这处设施。

column3: You're still searching for answers. Chasing glitches. Waiting for movement - any movement. The Surgery Labs just went live - now's your chance…
column4: 你仍在寻找答案，追踪每一个异常信号，等待任何一点动静。外科实验室刚刚恢复运转——机会来了……

column3: Blunt's been restoring power and comms area-by-area so we can track movement - but how is the dome connected? If you could trace the SAT NAV links on the roof…
column4: 布伦特正在逐区恢复电力和通讯，方便我们追踪动静——可穹顶是怎么接入网络的？要是能追查到屋顶上的卫星导航线路……

column3: You're trying to figure out why Blunt is diverting power to inaccessible areas of the SRI Complex, when a distress call comes in - somebody down by Reception!
column4: 你还在调查布伦特为何把电力转到SRI综合楼里那些进不去的区域，突然接到一通求救电话——有人被困在前台附近！

column3: Everyone knows - zombies don’t DO drawers. Or slit Doctors' throats. Blunt made a run for it. Went over to the other side - least he left your COM systems on.
column4: 谁都知道——僵尸可不会翻抽屉，更不会割开医生的喉咙。布伦特跑了，投靠了另一边。好在他走之前没关掉你的通讯系统。

column3: Perimeter breach - outside. Time to take Rowdy on patrol and see what he's made of. Shouldn't trust him yet - but right now, you're praying you can...
column4: 外围防线被突破。该带罗迪去巡逻，看看他有几斤几两了。现在还不能信任他——但此刻，你只能祈祷他靠得住……

column3: You're hungry - not \"eat a survivor\" hungry, but still hungry. There might be food down at the [LOCATION].
column4: 你饿了——倒不是饿到想吃幸存者的地步，但确实饿了。[LOCATION]那边也许有吃的。

column3: Trying to keep power running through the complex is a pain in the ass. Get some electricals from the [LOCATION].
column4: 要让整个综合楼保持供电真是让人头疼。去[LOCATION]弄些电器零件。

column3: Radio parts. Old cable. Broken coils. Anything to catch a signal - start looking around the [LOCATION].
column4: 收音机零件、旧电缆、坏线圈——任何能接收信号的东西都行。去[LOCATION]附近找找。

column3: Meds? Check. Figs? Check. Machinery parts? Check - wait! Where ARE the machinery parts?! Still in the [LOCATION].
column4: 药品？有了。无花果？有了。机械零件？有了——等等！机械零件到底在哪？！还落在[LOCATION]！

column3: You've been eyeing a promising crate near the [LOCATION] for days. But too much zombie activity - until now.
column4: 这几天你一直盯着[LOCATION]附近一只看起来很有料的箱子。可那里僵尸太多——直到现在。

column3: Progress is difficult without the right scientific equipment. Gather some weird science stuff from the [LOCATION].
column4: 没有合适的科研设备，研究很难推进。去[LOCATION]收集些古怪的科学材料。

column3: You're a taco away from starvation. If there's nothing yummy growing near the [LOCATION], then crates will do.
column4: 再不吃个玉米卷就要饿死了。要是[LOCATION]附近长不出好吃的，那就去翻箱子吧。

column3: Crates! On the [LOCATION] surveillance cams. How hard can it possibly be to just - go and get them?
column4: [LOCATION]的监控画面里有箱子！直接过去拿能有多难？

column3: Meatheads messed up the camp near the [LOCATION] - but they uncovered a couple of new crates while they were at it.
column4: 那帮蠢僵尸把[LOCATION]旁的营地搞得一团糟——不过也顺带翻出了几个新箱子。

column3: As Shooter used to say, \"Supplies are the difference between us and the dead\". Huh. Nothing like telling it like it is.
column4: 正如神枪手常说的：“物资，就是我们和死人的区别。”嗯，话糙理不糙。

column3: You'll go mad if you don’t get some company. Possible survivor alert near the [LOCATION]. Madness can wait.
column4: 再没人作伴你就要疯了。[LOCATION]附近可能有幸存者。发疯的事以后再说。

column3: Zombies don’t cry - so that must be a survivor you hear on the monitor. Destination [LOCATION], the mission is ON!
column4: 僵尸不会哭——你在监视器上听到的一定是幸存者。目标：[LOCATION]，出发！

column3: Civilians. Workers. Doctors and nurses. Each and every survivor has value. You're starting again - the human race.
column4: 平民、工人、医生和护士——每个幸存者都有价值。你要重新开始——为了人类。

column3: Curly-haired kid, name of Enzo, wants you to save his buddy. Got lost looking for video games near the [LOCATION].
column4: 一个叫恩佐的卷发男孩想请你救他的伙伴。那孩子在[LOCATION]附近找电子游戏时走丢了。

column3: Today? You're not going to die. You're going to live. It's the meatbags down at the [LOCATION] who are gonna die.
column4: 今天？你可不会死。你要活下去。要死的是[LOCATION]那帮行尸走肉！

column3: Take back the [LOCATION]. Don’t let the creepers creep, the biters bite, and the crawlers snuff out your life.
column4: 夺回[LOCATION]。别让那些爬的、咬的、拖着身子走的东西要了你的命。

column3: The [LOCATION] is infested. You're going to have to kill some zombies. And then kill some more. Get it done.
column4: [LOCATION]已被僵尸占领。杀一批，再杀一批，直到清干净为止。

column3: You need to set an example, show how it's done. You raise your hand and [LOCATION]'s zombies are history.
column4: 你得以身作则，示范给大家看。你举起了手——[LOCATION]的僵尸就此成为历史。

column3: Big party night down by the [LOCATION]. Want to get armpit-deep in zombies? Now's your chance!
column4: [LOCATION]那边今晚有场盛大派对。想被僵尸淹到腋窝吗？机会来了！

column3: The advance party must have bought it - biters running wild around the [LOCATION]. Now YOU'RE the advance party.
column4: 先遣队肯定完蛋了——咬人怪在[LOCATION]四周横行。现在你就是先遣队。

column3: The [LOCATION] is lighting up like a Christmas tree - multiple incoming! Get down there and seal it up!
column4: [LOCATION]像圣诞树一样亮成一片——大批僵尸来袭！赶过去，把那里封锁住！

column3: SRI research material is like gold dust - if you're going to find out what makes Savehaven tick. Don’t go alone.
column4: SRI的研究资料比金粉还珍贵——如果你想弄清安全区到底是怎么运转的。别一个人去。

column3: Zombie incursion - the [LOCATION]'s gone red. Don’t go down there unless you're packing back-up.
column4: 僵尸入侵——[LOCATION]已标红。不带帮手就别去。

column3: Your research project for today is \"Biters\" - Biters in the [LOCATION]. Take an escort and find out what you can.
column4: 今天的研究课题是“咬人怪”——[LOCATION]的咬人怪。带上护卫，能查到多少查多少。

column3: Survivor just GOTTA get back to the [LOCATION]. Left something valuable - apparently. Hope it's not a last request.
column4: 那个幸存者非要回[LOCATION]不可，说是落下了值钱的东西。但愿这不是他的临终遗愿。

column3: Going on patrol today with someone whose nickname is \"Deadeye\". That's either a good thing - or a very, very BAD thing.
column4: 今天和一个外号“弹无虚发”的人一起巡逻。这要么是好事——要么是非常、非常糟糕的事。

column3: Survivor's got a PhD in AstroBiology - swears the systems in the [LOCATION] are viable. Who are you to argue?
column4: 这位幸存者是天体生物学博士——坚称[LOCATION]的系统还能用。你又有什么资格反驳？

column3: Dear Shooter, when ya coming to get me? Sure, I got back-up, but if I hear \"yes, ma'am\" one more time I'll SCREAM. Love E.
column4: 亲爱的神枪手，你什么时候来接我？我是有帮手了，可要是再听到一句“是，女士”，我真要尖叫了。爱你的伊夫林。

column3: It's download day. Gather all the [LOCATION]'s data, shut down the biters, save your progress and reload.
column4: 今天是下载日。收集[LOCATION]的全部数据，干掉咬人怪，保存进度，然后重新装弹。

column3: You'll want some help securing the [LOCATION] - you need to set up an airwave scan, and that takes time.
column4: 你得找人帮忙守住[LOCATION]——架设电波扫描需要时间。

column3: Escort duty - you're up. Clear the [LOCATION] and set up the checkpoint sensor locations. Whatever THOSE are…
column4: 轮到你负责护送了。清理[LOCATION]，再架好检查站的传感器——管它是什么玩意儿……

column3: This creature is a result of sick genetic SHS experiments. Twisted and cowardly it still provides a great threat.
